title: Ground Truth's claimed com.anicca.daemon.plist EnvironmentVariables key list is factually wrong — 6 of the 10 cited keys do not exist in the actual live file, nor in its install-time template
evidence: behavioral-spec.md's Ground Truth section (the paragraph beginning 'The genesis loop actually running on this machine right now is com.anicca.daemon') states, as a 'confirmed via plutil -convert xml1 -o -' fact, that the plist's EnvironmentVariables dict contains: ANICCA_FREE_MODEL, ANICCA_FUNDED_MODEL, ANICCA_HOME, ANICCA_LEAN_MODEL, ANICCA_REPO, BASE_RPC_URL, COMPUTE_RESERVE_USDC, HOME, PATH, YIELD_MIN_DEPLOY_USDC.

Independently re-running the EXACT cited command right now: `plutil -convert xml1 -o - ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.anicca.daemon.plist` shows the EnvironmentVariables dict contains ONLY 4 keys: ANICCA_HOME, ANICCA_REPO, HOME, PATH. A grep count of the other 6 claimed keys (ANICCA_FREE_MODEL, ANICCA_FUNDED_MODEL, ANICCA_LEAN_MODEL, BASE_RPC_URL, COMPUTE_RESERVE_USDC, YIELD_MIN_DEPLOY_USDC) against the live plutil output returns 0.

This is not recent drift from a prior implementation attempt: `~/anicca/runtime/com.anicca.daemon.plist.template` (the install.sh:149-152-rendered source of truth for this exact file) ALSO only ever defines 4 keys (HOME, ANICCA_HOME, ANICCA_REPO, PATH) — the 6 extra keys the spec cites have never been part of this plist's design at all.

The plist file's own mtime (`ls -la`) is today, well before this review session, and `launchctl list | grep anicca.daemon` + `ps -p <pid> -o command=` confirm the daemon process (`node /Users/anicca/anicca/runtime/loop/index.mjs`) is genuinely the one this plist governs — so this is the correct, live file being checked, not a stale copy.

ANICCA_FREE_MODEL/ANICCA_LEAN_MODEL/ANICCA_FUNDED_MODEL are real env-var names used elsewhere (`runtime/loop/tier.mjs:29-31`, `runtime/loop/config.mjs:47-49` — but supplied there via config.mjs's own DEFAULTS, not the plist), and BASE_RPC_URL/COMPUTE_RESERVE_USDC/YIELD_MIN_DEPLOY_USDC are real names used elsewhere in the codebase too — meaning this looks like a plausible-sounding but unverified/fabricated claim (real symbol names assembled into a citation that was never actually checked against this specific file), rather than a random hallucination or a copy-paste of a different file's content.
why_it_matters: This project's own HONESTY RULES (CLAUDE.md Rule 1: 'Verify before claiming... confirmed without verification = fabrication = sin') exist specifically to catch this class of error: a Ground Truth section presented as independently confirmed ('confirmed via plutil -convert xml1 -o -') that is empirically false when re-checked right now. It does not break REQ-106's core mechanism (adding one new ANICCA_INSTANCE key + before/after plutil diff works regardless of what else is in the dict), but it undermines the specific evidentiary claim the spec rests its 'this file is definitely the daemon's real env source, confirmed by direct read' argument on, and an implementer relying on the stated key list (e.g. assuming ANICCA_FUNDED_MODEL is already there and just needs a new sibling key added) would be operating on a false premise about the file's current contents.
recommendation: Before implementation, re-run `plutil -convert xml1 -o - ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.anicca.daemon.plist` fresh and replace the Ground Truth section's claimed key list with the actual 4 keys (ANICCA_HOME, ANICCA_REPO, HOME, PATH) — which also matches `runtime/com.anicca.daemon.plist.template`, the file's own install-time source of truth. The REQ-106/PROP-106 mechanism itself (add ANICCA_INSTANCE, reload, before/after diff) needs no design change, only a correction of this one factual citation.
